description: A Perl script that analyzes the output of 'git verify-pack -v' to produce statistics about git pack files, including sizes, path sizes, delta trees, and depths. It can also output detailed tree structures and filenames associated with objects.
published: main variables and functions used for processing pack data

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical measures (min, max, total, mean, median, std deviation) for a list of numeric data.

methods.name: print_stats
methods.description: Prints formatted statistical summary for a dataset.

methods.name: dig
methods.description: Recursively traverses the delta tree starting from a given object, collecting size and path size data, and optionally printing tree structure.
